name: Pristine Spider Silk
summary: In Duskwood, venomous spiders yield the fine thread Stormwind mages need for robes that endure enchantments.

sections.title: Weaving the Arcane
sections.body: Stormwind mages need silk strong enough to bear enchantments and an adept’s wear. Tailors use common spider silk, but strands from carrion recluses and black widow hatchlings in Duskwood are more resilient. Mages from the Wizard’s Sanctum send rising adepts into those woods to gather it. Master tailor Wynne Larson then weaves the silk into a robe for an adept.

faq.q: Where does Pristine Spider Silk come from?
aliases: where to get pristine spider silk
faq.answer: Pristine Spider Silk comes from carrion recluses and black widow hatchlings in Duskwood.

faq.q: Who crafts garments from this silk?
faq.answer: Wynne Larson, a clothier in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, weaves the gathered silk into a robe for the Wizard’s Sanctum.

faq.q: Why do the mages require this specific silk?
faq.answer: The mages need silk resilient enough for an adept’s robe to bear enchantments and wear. Silk from Duskwood’s spiders has the needed strength and quality.

angles.text: As a mage of Stormwind, you are sent into Duskwood to gather this fine thread and earn a robe suited to your growing arcane stature.
As a tailor, you work with delicate, resilient thread gathered from deadly spiders. It is a fine natural textile for magical robes.
